user.title: Connect Belgee X50
user.description: Choose how X50 Relay and Gateway send data to Home Assistant.

data_description.installation_id: Do not use an IP address. This ID separates the real head unit from AVD installations.
data_description.public_base_url: Externally reachable base URL, for example https://ha.example.com. A local 192.168.x.x address will not work outside your home network.
data_description.connection_mode: relay accepts Relay push; gateway_push accepts outbound Gateway push; auto accepts both and prefers fresh Relay; gateway_poll is local diagnostics.
data_description.pairing_device: Relay and Gateway receive separate tokens. In Auto, choose which one to pair first.
data_description.gateway_url: Used only for local gateway_poll diagnostics. Normal Gateway push needs no VPN or incoming address.
data_description.gateway_token: Stored for future protected operations. Current direct Gateway telemetry is read-only.

pair.title: Pair X50 device
pair.description:
Enter this code in the selected Relay or Gateway. HA address: `{public_base_url}`

One-time code:

## `{pairing_code}`

The code is valid for {expires_minutes} minutes. Then select Check.

pair_confirm.title: Confirm X50 device
pair_confirm.description:
Found **{device_name}**, version `{relay_version}`.

Compare the fingerprint shown on the device:

## `{fingerprint}`

Confirm only when both values match.

error.invalid_public_url: Enter a complete public URL starting with http:// or https://, without a query or fragment.
error.public_url_required: A public Home Assistant URL is required for outbound pairing.
error.invalid_gateway_url: Enter a complete Gateway URL starting with http:// or https://, without a query or fragment.
error.gateway_url_required: Gateway URL is required for direct mode.
error.relay_not_connected: The selected device has not claimed this code yet. Enter it on the device and check again.

abort.pairing_expired: The pairing code expired. Start pairing again.
